note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay mapping, not sourced record by record). The economy is mapped as a mixed economy (privatisations in the 1990s alongside large state enterprises); trade as managed trade inside Mercosur, whose Treaty of Asunción came into force on Cardoso's first day in office (Wikipedia: 1998 Brazilian general election); conscription as selective (compulsory in law, with only part of each cohort called up); healthcare as a national health service (the universal public health system); energy as a mix dominated by hydropower.
